text:
dan: Where's the quickest saved search for org=acme model=gen-xl route=/v1/completions in EU that shows 5xx + kv-cache misses? Need it for a short postmortem.

sara: Quick answer — use the saved search I just linked: https://logs.redwood.internal/saved/acme-eu-genxl-5xx-kvmiss
It filters org, model, route and looks for 5xx and kv cache miss events. Open it and change the time range to 15m.

liam: can you paste the raw query? easier for me to reuse in dashboards / alerts.

sara: Sure:
```
org:"acme" AND model:"gen-xl" AND route:"/v1/completions" AND (status >= 500 AND status < 600) AND (kv_cache.status : "miss" OR kv_cache.hit:false)
```
That is what the saved search stores in the UI. Replace status clause with `status:5xx` if you prefer shorthand.

natalie: For alerts — if this is for the postmortem, don't touch prod alerting yet. If we want a temp alert to catch regressions set:
- scope: org:acme + model:gen-xl + route:/v1/completions
- condition: error_rate(5m) > 2.5% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets
- notify: #eng-sre + oncall
I'll draft a PR for the alert rule if you want.

liam: That scope looks good. For the runbook, could we add the saved-search link + query snippet + example dashboard panel? saves time for handoffs.

sara: I'll pin the saved search and add it to the team dashboard. Steps I used:
1) Open the saved search link
2) Click "Save to dashboard" -> choose "eng-sre / Ops Route Filters" panel
3) In the saved-search settings, toggle "Share with org" and add tags: `acme,gen-xl,eu,ops`

infra-bot: deploy-bot: saved-search "acme-eu-genxl-5xx-kvmiss" was pinned to dashboard "eng-sre / Ops Route Filters" by sara at 2026-03-17T15:20:30Z

dan: Perfect — can you also export the query as a snippet so I can paste into the postmortem? small code block in the doc would be great.

sara: Exported snippet and added to the postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/pm/postmortems/acme-genxl-2026-03-17#logs
Snippet: `org:"acme" AND model:"gen-xl" AND route:"/v1/completions" AND status:5xx AND kv_cache.miss:true`

liam: One more thing — if someone needs to create the same saved search programmatically:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://logs.redwood.internal/api/savedsearches' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"acme-eu-genxl-5xx-kvmiss","query":"org:\"acme\" AND model:\"gen-xl\" AND route:\"/v1/completions\" AND status:5xx AND kv_cache.miss:true","tags":["acme","gen-xl","eu","ops"]}'
```
(change token and host to your env)

natalie: Good. After the postmortem, let's decide whether to keep the alert (maybe widen to all gen-xl routes in EU) or revert. For now I'll schedule a 30m sync with oncall tomorrow to review.

dan: Thanks all — that covers what I needed. :thumbsup:
